scoring_justification: Compare reported gaps to digitized paper reference and enforce monotonic size trend; recompute from raw is infeasible without rerunning the full TDLDA pipeline in the verifier.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden reference optical gaps for the three quantum dots
hidden_assets.source_provenance: digitized from Fig. 3 of Troparevsky et al., J. Chem. Phys. 119, 2284 (2003)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Plot digitizer applied to the published TDLDA gap data points.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values correspond to the TDLDA optical gaps plotted in the paper Figure 3, which are the published results of the original study and serve as the authoritative reference for reproduction.

outputs.description: Optical gaps for the three wurtzite-derived CdSe quantum dots computed with TDLDA and the 2% cumulative oscillator strength rule.

steps.description: Check three gaps within tolerance and monotonic ordering
